title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're excited to announce the full launch of Spyglass, our innovative new tool, ready to empower all users with enhanced capabilities.

title: Intuitive File Management and Flexible Display
summary: We've introduced intuitive new controls that empower you to effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the visual presentation of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Explore Our New Public Roadmap!
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, where you can easily track recent updates, upcoming features, and future plans!

title: Smarter, Sleeker Checkboxes
summary: Experience effortless task management with our enhanced checkboxes, now featuring a modern design, larger click targets, and smooth drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience seamless teamwork with clearer real-time indicators that ensure you always know who's collaborating and what they're doing.

title: Effortless Discovery and Collaboration
summary: Unlock seamless teamwork by easily discovering and collaborating on all shared content, ensuring nothing important ever slips through the cracks.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're excited to open source Noeko's codebase, offering you maximum control and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is becoming truly global by adding comprehensive support for numerous international languages, enhancing accessibility for everyone.

title: Elevated Visual Themes
summary: We're refreshing our current themes and introducing an array of stunning new designs to provide a more personalized and visually appealing experience for your workspace.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Navigate your knowledge with unparalleled precision using the enhanced Constellation view, which now includes advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared items for a truly personalized exploration.

title: Find Exactly What You Need with Advanced Search and Curated Views
summary: Unlock unprecedented control over your knowledge with powerful new search filters and sorting options, enabling you to pinpoint specific information and save your customized views for instant access whenever you need them.

title: Flexible Note Organization
summary: Gain greater control over how you structure and interact with your ideas through new, dynamic display options for linked content.

title: Noeko Unleashed: Self-Hosting and Flexible Paid Plans
summary: We are excited to introduce Noeko's self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans, empowering users with more control and advanced features tailored to their operational needs.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're enhancing our greetings to perfectly match the time of day, providing a more personalized and accurate experience for everyone.

title: Direct Actions for List Items
summary: Effortlessly manage your content by performing quick actions like removing tags or deleting items directly from any list view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
